chapter.chapter: Chapter 2 — Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic, and Neutral

excerpts:
[CBSE Class X Science, sample question paper, 2022-23]
6. Anita added a drop each of diluted acetic acid and diluted hydrochloric acid on pH paper 1
and compared the colors. Which of the following is the correct conclusion?
(a) pH of acetic acid is more than that of hydrochloric acid.
(b) pH of acetic acid is less than that of hydrochloric acid.
(c) Acetic acid dissociates completely in aqueous solution.
(d) Acetic acid is a strong acid

[CBSE Class X Science, sample question paper, 2024-25]
4. An aqueous solution ‘A’ turns the phenolphthalein solution pink. On addition of
an aqueous solution ‘B’ to ‘A’, the pink colour disappears. Which of the following 1
statement is true for the solutions ‘A’ and ‘B’.
A. A is strongly basic and B is a weak base.
B. A is strongly acidic and B is a weak acid.
C. A has a pH greater than 7 and B has a pH less than 7.
D. A has a pH less than 7 and B has a pH greater than 7.

[INJSO 2016 — question paper]
21. Anand wanted to prepare a salt solution of pH 1.0. For that he used solutions of a
strong monovalent base and acid. He tried different combinations to obtain the
required solution. Can you help him to decide which one is the most correct
combination of statements given below?
I. 100ml of (M/10) acid and 100ml of (M/10) alkali.
II. 55ml of (M/10) acid and 45ml of (M/10) alkali.
III. 10ml of (M/10) acid and 90ml of (M/10) alkali.
IV. 75ml of (M/5) acid and 25ml of (M/5) alkali
a) I and III b) II and IV
c) Only II d) Only IV

[CBSE Class X Science, sample question paper, 2025-26]
21. Which of the following substances when dissolved in equal volume of water,
will have the highest pH value? 1
A. Sulphuric acid
B. Acetic acid
C. Magnesium hydroxide
D. Sodium hydroxide
